explanation: A Canaanite god, often associated with fertility and rain. Hosea criticizes Israel's worship of Ba'al instead of Yahweh.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel, used as a representation of all Israel. Hosea warns Ephraim about the consequences of their sins and idolatry.
An action or thought that breaks God's laws and commands. Hosea describes Israel's sins and calls them to turn back to God.
To show genuine sorrow and regret for sins committed and seek God's forgiveness. Hosea urges Israel to repent of their sins and return to God.
God's grace and mercy that gives people the opportunity to be cleansed from their sins. Hosea emphasizes the importance of seeking God's forgiveness.
Consequences resulting from sin and disobedience toward God. Hosea warns that God's punishment will come upon Israel if they do not turn back to Him.
God's loving care and grace shown to people, even when they do not deserve it. Hosea speaks of God's mercy and His desire to forgive and restore His people.
